description: This file defines a registry and management system for ContextEngine instances, including registration, resolution, and compatibility handling with legacy session keys. It includes types, constants, functions for managing context engines, and a singleton registry.

methods.name: registerContextEngineForOwner
methods.description: Registers a context engine implementation under a specific owner, with options for refresh control.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Public SDK method to register a context engine without owner privileges.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function for a registered context engine by ID.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all registered context engine IDs.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate ContextEngine based on configuration, with fallback to default.
